The app is built and every flow works in a real browser, but **I couldn't compare it to the Figma design**. The Figma API rejects the token with `403 "Token expired"`, both through the MCP server and when I call it directly with `$FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN`. So the layout follows the spec's written description, not the frames. That leaves the acceptance line "matches the Figma frames in structure, spacing and proportion" **unconfirmed**.

**What I checked** (Playwright, headless Chromium, 1440px and 390px wide):
- **Login:** `ng build` is clean. `/` goes to `/login`. Submitting empty shows "required" errors, and wrong credentials show an error. `admin`/`admin` sets `isLoggedIn` and lands on `/dashboard`.
- **Guards:** a logged-in visit to `/login` redirects to `/dashboard`, and a logged-out visit to `/users` redirects to `/login`.
- **User menu:** it stays fully inside the viewport at both widths, closes on an outside click, and Sign Out logs you out.
- **Dashboard:** all 8 tiles render, and the log viewer adds a line every 3 seconds.
- **Users:** create, edit and delete all go through the mock API and the table updates. The edit dialog splits "John Smith" into first and last name correctly. Details and edit dialogs close on a backdrop click or Escape. Edit → "Delete user" opens the delete confirmation with the member still selected.
- **Console:** no errors.

**Guesses that need the Figma frames:**
- **Dashboard layout:** four metric tiles in a row; then throughput (two columns wide), service health and data summary; then logs across the full width.
- **Badge colours:** Admin dark, Editor blue, Viewer outlined; Active green, Inactive red.
- **Footer content:** the brand name "Blueprint", the logo, and the footer link columns are placeholders I made up.
- **Sizes and spacing:** all widths, spacing and type sizes are my own choices.

All colours, spacing, radii, control heights and type sizes are defined once as CSS variables in `src/styles.scss`, with shared button, badge, field and card styles. Component styles use only those variables; the one exception is the three screen-width breakpoints, because CSS variables don't work in media queries.

**Main files:**
- `src/app/app.config.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `app.component.html` (only `<router-outlet />`)
- `src/app/core/`: the auth service and guards, the mock database, the users service and the user model
- `src/app/layouts/`: the login shell and the signed-in shell (header, user menu, footer)
- `src/app/pages/`: login, dashboard, and users (the table and all four dialogs)
- `src/app/shared/`: the avatar (falls back to initials) and the modal

To run it: `npx @angular/cli@19 serve`. Once the token is renewed, I can pull the three Figma nodes and adjust the layout and variable values to match.
